_comment: Lifecycle event templates (reusable rotation pool). Envelope captured from real DevTools payloads 2026-08-10:
{ eventType, data: [ {key, value, type: Text|Numeric|Date} ], reason, comments: '', tradeIds: [id] } —
comments and tradeIds are added by the client (trigger-event.js), rows carry only eventType/data/reason.
All 5 captured event types are represented below. VALUES are placeholders (repo red line: real portfolio/
counterparty values live only in the private copy); the SHAPES (keys, types, reason enums) are verbatim.
Date-typed values use {{TODAY}} / {{T_PLUS_2}} tokens, resolved at request time (T+2 = business days,
weekends skipped) so rows never go stale. The target tradeId comes from the event-ids CONSUMABLE pool,
